subject: Proposal: shared-cost model for Trust Center automation & evidence exports
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-20T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: shared-cost model for Trust Center automation & evidence exports

Team —

Quick summary: Acme Metrics is interested in bringing Trust Center tooling (evidence exports + automated attestations) into a pilot. Procurement wants to avoid taking the full platform cost on day one and asked whether Redwood can propose a shared-cost / implementation-cost split where Redwood covers part of the onboarding engineering effort and Acme pays a reduced first-year license.

I sketched a proposal and attached a small sample export from Vanta to show how we can map evidence assets into the Trust Center UI. Key asks:
- Can we offer a 6-month discounted license (50% off) in exchange for Redwood covering up to 40 engineer hours for the initial integration?
- Can we bundle an evidence-export automation (script + onboarding) as a fixed-fee deliverable rather than time-and-materials?

Ben — could you run a back-of-envelope on the cost side (license discount + implementation cost) and confirm whether margin remains >40% at that discount?
Monica — if this looks viable, can you draft a one-page SOW we can show Procurement? Keep it high level: deliverables, acceptance, and a 30-day rollback clause.
Neha — loop in Security for any data retention or export limits we need to surface to the customer.

Attachments: Vanta_Evidence_Export_sample.json (small sample mapping), draft checklist notes.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

(Attachment stub: Vanta_Evidence_Export_sample.json)

From: Emma Chen <emma@acmemetrics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Acme Metrics Procurement <procure@acmemetrics.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shared-cost model for Trust Center automation & evidence exports

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the quick overview and the sample export. This is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we escalate to Procurement:

1) Can you provide a short pricing table that shows: list price, proposed pilot price, and the break-even point (i.e., when we'd move to full-rate)?
2) What exactly is included in the "evidence-export automation" fixed fee (scripts only, or also onboarding sessions and runbook)?
3) We need to confirm data residency for any exports (we prefer that evidence exports remain within our EU region for GDPR, though our legal team is okay if the tool stores metadata in the US if there is a robust retention policy).

Procurement has asked for a draft SOW and a copy of any template security questionnaire answers you can share. If you can get a one-pager and the pricing table by EOD Friday (5/22), that would help move this along.

Best,
Emma Chen
Lead Product Operations | Acme Metrics
emma@acmemetrics.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shared-cost model for Trust Center automation & evidence exports

Folks —

I put together a concise SOW and a pricing table for the pilot (attached). Highlights:
- Pilot length: 6 months; pilot license: 50% of list for first 6 months; auto-renews to list unless either party gives 30-day notice.
- Implementation: fixed fee $12k which includes: evidence-export script delivery, two 90-minute onboarding sessions, one runbook, and a sandbox validation window (2 weeks). Any additional work is T&M.
- Security: exports will be delivered as encrypted JSON bundles. For EU customers we can stage the exports on an EU S3 bucket and provide proof of deletion after ingestion.
- Acceptance: acceptance is sign-off by Acme on the sandbox validation checklist.

Ben — quick numbers: at 50% pilot discount + $12k fixed fee, our margin remains ~48% assuming 40 hours of engineer time capitalized at our internal rate. If we extend engineer coverage beyond 40 hours, margin dips below 35% — we should avoid that unless we increase the fixed fee.

Laura — can you confirm whether Legal needs any special terms for the rollback clause and the EU export handling? If so, I recommend we add a short amendment that clarifies deletion verification and liability limits.

Attached: SOW_AcmeMetrics_TrustCenter_integration_v1.2.docx, pricing-table.csv

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
